MAC urges Beijing to recognize ROC's existence after Xi's remarks
summary: Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA) The Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) on Thursday urged Beijing to recognize the continued existence of the Republic of China (ROC) and respect Taiwan's democracy after Chinese President Xi Jinping (習近平) reiterated that unification with Taiwan was inevitable.

title: Taiwan lawmakers clash over nuclear power referendum
summary: Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA) Ruling and opposition lawmakers clashed during a televised presentation Thursday over a Nov. 28 referendum on nuclear power, disagreeing over its economic benefits, electricity costs, energy security and nuclear safety.

title: China pressure behind PNG's abrupt expulsion of Taiwan diplomats: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA) Taiwan foreign ministry officials said Thursday that China was behind Papua New Guinea's (PNG) sudden decision last week to expel Taiwanese diplomats and demand the closure of the Taiwan representative office there.

title: Presidential Office vows stronger self-defense after G7 statement
summary: Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA) The Presidential Office said Thursday that Taiwan would continue strengthening its self-defense capabilities and resilience following a joint statement by Group of Seven (G7) foreign ministers emphasizing the importance of peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait.

title: U.S. fellowship participants will not access classified Taiwan data: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Nov. 12 (CNA)U.S. federal government employees participating in a new study program in Taiwan will not have access to sensitive or confidential Taiwanese government information, Deputy Foreign Minister Chen Ming-chi (陳明祺) said Thursday.
